message: 信じる道

name: Synn
message: 「...Sigh.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Synn, is something wrong? You look pretty pale this morning.」

name: Synn
message: 「Ah, yeah. It's nothing...」

name: Nanaka
message: 「I'm asking because it definitely doesn't look like nothing.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Got something on your mind? If so, I'm here to listen.」
Ever since returning to the Human World, I've been thinking about it nonstop.
Even so, I still haven't worked up the readiness to tell Nanaka or everyone else about what happened in the Demon World.
I haven't been able to muster the courage to confess that I'm the Demon Lord.
I just don't know what I should do...

name: Synn
message: 「...Thanks, Nanaka.」

name: Synn
message: 「Really though, I'm fine...」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Oh, yeah? Well, if you say so...」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Mr. President, Mr. President!」

name: Lolotte
message: 「I'm not sure how to write this report, though.」

name: Synn
message: 「Ah, this is, um... how did this go again...?」

name: Misa
message: 「Hey, Sakura-kun! What's with that total lack of motivation!」

name: Synn
message: 「Eh, ah, sorry...」

name: Ria
message: 「Now, now, don't get angry, don't get angry.\s07」

name: Ria
message: 「Everyone has their off days, right?」

name: Paqy
message: 「Ria-chan's having *that* time of the month!?」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Hohou!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Funny, I happen to have a rolling pin in my bag, and--」

name: Paqy
message: 「Satsugai!」

name: Synn
message: 「Sorry, everyone. I'm really fine, so...」

name: Ria
message: 「Yeah. I believe you, Synn-kun.」

name: Misa
message: 「Good grief... For Ria-senpai's sake, I'll let you off the hook today.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「So, what happened on that day...?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Never mind about that.」

name: Misa
message: 「Yes, let's change the subject.」

name: Ria
message: 「Come to think of it...」

name: Ria
message: 「I heard Professor Sengen'in suddenly resigned from the academy today.」

name: Misa
message: 「Yes. It's a shame, considering what a wonderful teacher he was...」

name: Nanaka
message: 「I feel like he was just strict, though...」

name: Lolotte
message: 「I feel like a huge limb has been ripped off my shoulders.」

name: Ria
message: 「A weight lifted off your shoulders, you mean.\s02」
So that confirms Professor Sengen'in's entire identity was a lie.
He infiltrated the academy to frame Melilot-san and me...
Or perhaps he had some other, grander objective.
Though I couldn't possibly imagine what that might be...

name: Paqy
message: 「What's the matter, Demon Lord? Aren't you gonna go?」

name: Synn
message: 「Yeah...」
What kind of face am I even supposed to make when I see Melilot-san...
Melilot-san told me not to worry about it.
Yet with these very hands, I undeniably hurt Melilot-san.
The person I admire and yearn for more than anyone else...

name: Paqy
message: 「Jeez, stop moping around forever.」

name: Paqy
message: 「If Hikkii told you not to worry about it, you oughta just trust her words.」

name: Paqy
message: 「Or are you saying you don't even trust her that much, Demon Lord?」

name: Synn
message: 「That's... not true.」

name: Paqy
message: 「Then that's good enough, ain't it.」

name: Synn
message: 「...We did make a promise, after all.」

name: Paqy
message: 「Huh?」

name: Synn
message: 「The deputy librarian work. I promised I'd be there today, too.」

name: Paqy
message: 「Heh heh heh... What the hell is that.」

name: Synn
message: 「A promise is a promise, so...」

name: Paqy
message: 「Well... I think that's just fine.」
It was a mere excuse, not even worthy of being called a facade.
A fleeting signpost for the heart to cling to, more fragile than straw.

name: Melilot
message: 「Sigh...」

name: Melilot
message: 「I wonder if he won't be coming today...」

name: Melilot
message: 「Sakura-kun...」

name: Melilot
message: 「Eek!?」

name: Synn
message: 「Ah, I'm sorry, Melilot-san...」

name: Melilot
message: 「S-Sakura-kun...」

name: Melilot
message: 「You came after all...」

name: Synn
message: 「Um... was it a bad idea for me to come...?」

name: Melilot
message: 「Of course not! That couldn't possibly be the case...」

name: Melilot
message: 「Because I'm happy that you came, Sakura-kun.」

name: Melilot
message: 「I thought you might be bothered by what happened back then and wouldn't come anymore...」

name: Melilot
message: 「If you had kept your distance like that, I was on the verge of giving up.」

name: Synn
message: 「It's not that I'm not bothered by it, though...」

name: Melilot
message: 「That's precisely where your kindness lies, Sakura-kun. Please hold your head high.」

name: Melilot
message: 「Besides, you properly came for me like this, didn't you?」

name: Synn
message: 「...Is it really okay for me to stay by your side from now on, Melilot-san?」

name: Melilot
message: 「...What do you want to do, Sakura-kun?」
I already know what I want to do.
There's no room left to hesitate at this point.

name: Synn
message: 「From now on, I...」

name: Synn
message: 「I want to stay by your side, Melilot-san!」

name: Melilot
message: 「Because I... also want you to stay by my side forever, Sakura-kun...」

name: Synn
message: 「...Is it because I'm the Demon Lord?」

name: Melilot
message: 「Please don't tease me.」

name: Melilot
message: 「Because you're the kind Sakura-kun who bothers with someone like me...」

name: Melilot
message: 「Who cares about even someone like me...」

name: Melilot
message: 「That's... why.」

name: Synn
message: 「So then, you don't know what Soltia's objective is or anything, right?」

name: Melilot
message: 「Yes, for the time being.」

name: Melilot
message: 「We can safely assume the incident in the Demon World was aimed at getting you and me to fight each other, Sakura-kun.」

name: Melilot
message: 「Or perhaps she also thought that if one of us fell, disposing of the other would be easy.」

name: Synn
message: 「Because I was instigated by Soltia...」

name: Melilot
message: 「In all likelihood, when you came into contact with her beforehand, she planted some kind of suggestion in you.」

name: Synn
message: 「Now that you mention it...」
The illusion of my shoulder, where Soltia had stroked it, stiffening as if frozen.

name: Melilot
message: 「It seems something comes to mind.」

name: Melilot
message: 「It was your first time in the Demon World, and your stamina was quite drained as well...」

name: Melilot
message: 「She must have planned her strategy with even that in mind.」

name: Synn
message: 「What was she planning to do after defeating us?」

name: Melilot
message: 「I am of the Nive Clan, and there was the possibility that you are the Demon Lord, Sakura-kun.」

name: Melilot
message: 「The most likely objective would be eliminating factors that could obstruct Re-Crea...」

name: Melilot
message: 「In other words, Soltia is aiming to bring Re-Crea to completion.」

name: Synn
message: 「No way...!」

name: Melilot
message: 「There are still things we don't know, and it's only a possibility, though.」

name: Synn
message: 「Even so, we can't just leave this alone!」

name: Melilot
message: 「Yes, you're right.」

name: Melilot
message: 「You and I, Sakura-kun, and everyone in the Crusaders...」

name: Melilot
message: 「We must all work together to repel Re-Crea.」

name: Melilot
message: 「To that end, I'll have you become a splendid Demon Lord, Sakura-kun.」

name: Synn
message: 「Special training to be the Demon Lord?」

name: Melilot
message: 「Yes.」

name: Melilot
message: 「I will have you learn to control your own power perfectly, Sakura-kun.」

name: Synn
message: 「...Do you think I can do it...?」

name: Melilot
message: 「...Do you trust me, Sakura-kun?」

name: Melilot
message: 「Well, do you...?」

name: Synn
message: 「Ah, um, of course I do! I trust you completely, Melilot-san!」

name: Melilot
message: 「Heehee... Thank you.」

name: Melilot
message: 「Then, I trust in you, Sakura-kun.」

name: Melilot
message: 「I believe that if it's you, Sakura-kun, you will definitely see it through.」

name: Synn
message: 「Melilot-san...」

name: Melilot
message: 「Do you feel like you can be confident now?」

name: Synn
message: 「Yes. I'll definitely become the Demon Lord, you'll see!」

name: Melilot
message: 「Yes, let's do our best together.」

name: Melilot
message: 「Besides, I have to overcome my own weakness too...」

name: Synn
message: 「Protect everyone from Re-Crea.」

name: Synn
message: 「That's my... the Demon Lord's mission...」

name: Melilot
message: 「Yes. It's the same as mine.」

name: Synn
message: 「Still, that guy Bylous only wants to fight me, right.」

name: Melilot
message: 「He... Yes, that's true.」

name: Melilot
message: 「Depending on how he moves, how we act going forward might change as well, though...」

name: Synn
message: 「It'll be fine.」

name: Synn
message: 「I'm definitely not going to lose.」

name: Synn
message: 「Because you'll be with me and train me, right, Melilot-san?」

name: Synn
message: 「Then I'll beat Bylous, Re-Crea, anything--you'll see!」

name: Synn
message: 「Because I want to protect everyone, this world...」

name: Synn
message: 「And you, Melilot-san.」

name: Melilot
message: 「Sakura-kun...」

name: Melilot
message: 「The special training will be tough, you know?」

name: Synn
message: 「Bring it on!」

name: Synn
message: 「Because with you, Melilot-san, I feel like I can do anything!」

name: Melilot
message: 「Heehee...」

name: Melilot
message: 「Honestly, you're always so smooth...」

name: Synn
message: 「Melilot-san.」

name: Synn
message: 「Let's do our best together, okay?」

name: Melilot
message: 「That's just what I want.」
Facing each other and taking each other's hands, we no longer hesitate.
No matter what hardships await us, as long as the two of us are together, we'll surely be okay.
Whatever happens, the two of us will definitely overcome it!
